title: Codes & promos
subtitle: Promo campaigns used at partner scans: discounts Cable and partners share, or extra points.

effectValueHint.PointsMultiplier: Above 1, at most 10 (1.5, 2, 3). The higher of promo and boost wins — never multiplied.
effectValueHint.BonusPoints: A whole number, added on top of the scan's points

codeModeHint.Unique: Generate one-time PRM- codes and hand them out (export CSV).

rules.fixedPositive: A fixed discount must be more than 0 JOD
rules.multiplierRange: A multiplier is above 1 and at most 10
rules.bonusWhole: Bonus points must be a whole number of at least 1
rules.capPositive: The cap must be more than 0
rules.budgetPositive: The budget must be more than 0
rules.minAmountNegative: The minimum amount can't be negative
rules.budgetRequired: A budget is required when Cable pays part of the discount
rules.capRequired: A per-use cap is required when Cable pays part of a percent discount
rules.noAllWhenPartnerPays: The partner pays part of this discount (Cable share below 100%), so stations and providers must be Selected — never All.
rules.pickScope: Pick stations, service providers or both
rules.pickProvider: Select at least one service provider
rules.endsBeforeStart: The end must be after the start
rules.publicCodeFormat: 3–30 letters or digits (spaces and dashes are ignored)
rules.publicCodeReserved: Codes starting with PRM, PTR, GFT or CBL are reserved
rules.budgetBelowSpent: The budget can't be below the {{spent}} JOD Cable already paid

form.budgetExhaustedHint: Switched off automatically: Cable's budget is used up. Raise the budget to switch it back on.
form.textsHint: Shown on the user's card in both languages.
form.scopeLabelHint: Optional card text, e.g. "At Irbid car washes"
form.effectLocked: The campaign was already used: the effect type, value, cap and Cable's share are locked.
form.fundingHint: Cable's share of every discount; the rest is carried by the partner. Cable's part is capped by the budget.
form.fundingPointsHint: Points effects are paid by Cable's points budget; the share only matters for discounts.
form.budgetHint: The campaign switches off when it is used up
form.whereHint: A scan qualifies when the partner is inside the scope of its type; then category, city and minimum amount apply.
form.totalLimitHint: Claims by code · empty = no limit
form.codeModeLocked: Codes were already generated or claimed — the code mode can't change.
form.codeHint: Public = one shared code; Unique = one-time codes.

codes.publicMode: This campaign uses the public code {{code}}. Switch the code mode to Unique (before any claim) to generate codes.
codes.generateHint: Random PRM- + 8 characters (no 0 O 1 I L). Each can be added once.

assign.done: Given to {{assigned}} users ({{skipped}} skipped). They get a notification.
assign.inactive: Only an active, running campaign can be given to users.
assign.title: Give to users
assign.hint: Adds the promo to "My codes" with a push. Users who already hold it, reached the per-user limit or aren't new (new users only) are skipped.
assign.recipientsHint: One per line or separated by commas · {{users}} ids · {{phones}} phones
assign.allWarning: Every user gets this promo and a notification.
assign.confirmAll: Every user will get this promo and a push notification.
assign.confirmCity: Users of {{count}} cities will get this promo and a push notification.
assign.confirmUsers: {{count}} users will get this promo and a push notification.

userPromos.title: The user's promo codes
userPromos.revokeHint: "{{title}}" is removed from the user's codes. Only available promos can be revoked.
